status: awaiting user review; no gameplay implementation authorized yet

roles.name: Ward Weaver
roles.behaviour: A fragile wizard channels a forcefield onto its bodyguards. It stays vulnerable and tries to keep the guards between itself and the player.
roles.overlap: Forge Conjurer summons enemies, and Cinder Mender heals them; neither currently maintains a protective forcefield.

roles.name: Bodyguard Brute
roles.behaviour: A heavy guard advances to block approaches to the wizard and commits a short frontal sweep. Its shield link is a visible dependency on the living wizard.
roles.overlap: Mossbound Guard and Bastion Bulwark already cover melee/defender roles. This proposal adds escort positioning and externally supplied protection.

kenney.label: Armored crab-like brute; changes the creature identity

roles.name: Mend Acolyte
roles.behaviour: A support caster holds behind the attackers and commits a visible healing channel to a wounded ally. Pressure on the caster forces it to reposition.
roles.overlap: Cinder Mender already heals a wounded ally. Review whether this should be a new identity or an extension of that enemy; a new sprite alone is not a new behaviour.

roles.name: Rushwing
roles.behaviour: A fragile bat-like attacker closes through open lanes and uses short committed strikes. In a group, the wings approach from separate sides while the healer stays behind.
roles.overlap: Ruin Skitter already supplies a fast melee threat. The proposed distinction is a deliberate flanking group that can retreat toward its healer, not just higher speed.

roles.name: Snare Scribe
roles.behaviour: An enemy trap setter marks a small number of ground snares near escape routes. Placement is telegraphed; a triggered snare briefly constrains movement through the ordinary action scheduler.
roles.overlap: The playable Trapper already has a snare, and Mire Binder marks a denial ring. Enemy snare placement and coordination with a lobber would be new; exact hold rules need your review.

kenney.label: Brown hooded figure; distinct from the green player Trapper

roles.name: Siege Wisp
roles.behaviour: A fragile artillery creature commits a slow, clearly marked compact blast. It pressures the routes left open by the Snare Scribe.
roles.overlap: Crystal Bombardier already marks an area blast. This proposal needs a different compact footprint and intentional trap coordination; it does not imply moving projectile physics or firing through walls.

roles.name: Shield Bearer
roles.behaviour: A guard protects a limited frontal approach with a directional shield and repositions to keep a shooter behind cover. Its sides and rear remain vulnerable.
roles.overlap: Bastion Bulwark retaliates after taking damage, but there is no current directional shield formation. This shield is a local facing rule, unlike the wizard's shared forcefield.

kenney.label: Blue-helmet armored figure; also an archer candidate

roles.name: Pin Archer
roles.behaviour: A ranged soldier uses staggered firing lanes beside its shield bearer and exposes itself when the player flanks. Shots retain visible locked lines and friendly fire.
roles.overlap: Thornspitter and Canal Lancer already supply ranged/line pressure. The new distinction is maintaining a shield formation. These body sprites do not contain a clearly drawn bow; a shared weapon cue is proposed separately.

kenney.label: Gray hooded marksman; also a trap-setter candidate

roles.name: Banner Captain
roles.behaviour: A visible leader rallies a small group and directs it to pressure separate approaches. Its presence gives followers a small, clearly signalled attack bonus.
roles.overlap: Pack Chorister already gains damage from nearby allies. This reverses the dependency: followers depend on a vulnerable leader. Killing it removes the bonus from future attacks, without rewriting already committed strikes.

roles.name: Banner Follower
roles.behaviour: A modest soldier is manageable alone but pressures another approach while its captain is alive. The first implementation would cap the squad size.
roles.overlap: Mossbound Guard already covers a basic soldier. The proposed new behaviour is formation-dependent coordination; consider reusing the existing guard if a separate identity adds little.

kenney.label: Gray hooded follower; also proposed for other roles

combos.name: Wizard + bodyguard brutes
combos.intent: Kill or reach the vulnerable wizard to remove the brutes' protection.
rules: Proposed first version: the completed field fully blocks HP damage to linked brutes, never to the wizard.
The field visibly connects the caster and protected guards; it collapses when the wizard dies.
Place this encounter only where at least one approach to the wizard remains possible. No invulnerable wall across the only corridor.
Field radius, cast timing and interruption rules remain proposals; comment if you prefer damage reduction over full protection.
combos.counterplay: Flank the guards, use a clear ranged angle, or reach the wizard with a legal movement ability. Existing strict telegraph timing remains.
combos.biomes: Candidate homes: Fractured Archive or Ashen Bastion; placement is not yet selected.

cue.name: Forcefield bubble
cue.purpose: A static shield/bubble motif around protected brutes, plus a visible link to the caster. The link itself would remain drawn geometry.

combos.name: Healer + aggressive attackers
combos.intent: Choose between pressuring the healer and managing two flanking attackers.
rules: The healer commits a readable channel to one wounded ally; it does not heal everyone instantly.
Two attackers use different open approaches rather than standing in one queue.
No resurrection, unlimited summons, or new free enemy actions are proposed.
Cinder Mender already heals; comments can request reuse of that identity instead of another healer.
combos.counterplay: Separate an attacker from support, interrupt the healer, or use area attacks against a grouped retreat.
combos.biomes: Candidate home: Fungal Hollows; placement remains pending.

cue.name: Healing-channel mark
cue.purpose: A shared cross motif marks the healing target and distinguishes this support from a forcefield caster.

combos.name: Trapper + artillery
combos.intent: Read the safe routes between marked snares and a slow committed blast.
rules: Snares have a small cap and visible placement warnings; they are not hidden instant roots.
The artillery blast is locked before impact, and its geometry remains readable over terrain.
A placement check must preserve a legal escape route; attacks can still resolve before the player's next action under the current scheduler.
Exact snare duration and blast footprint require review; this does not add liquid or travelling-projectile simulation.
combos.counterplay: Advance before the zone fills, approach the artillery from a flank, or punish the fragile trap setter.
combos.biomes: Candidate homes: Fractured Archive or Glacial Observatory.

cue.name: Snare ground mark
cue.purpose: A static ground reticle helps show the snare; existing dotted attack outlines remain intact.

combos.name: Shield bearer + ranged attacker
combos.intent: Flank a local shield formation to expose its shooter.
rules: The guard's protection is directional and local; it is not the wizard's all-around shared field.
The shooter uses an offset firing lane. It does not gain permission to shoot through allies or walls.
Turning and attacks remain committed gameplay actions; no automatic presentation-driven blocking.
The native body art has no explicit bow. A small shared bow cue during aiming is a proposal, not a baked-in weapon sprite.
combos.counterplay: Attack from the side/rear, displace the guard, or enter the formation through another route.
combos.biomes: Candidate homes: Ashen Bastion or Sunken Aqueduct.

cue.name: Directional shield badge
cue.purpose: A shield motif identifies the guard; the facing boundary still needs a readable drawn arc. The existing bow icon can identify the shooter.

candidates.label: Ring badge; also a forcefield candidate

combos.name: Commander + weaker followers
combos.intent: Remove the leader to reduce coordinated pressure from its followers.
rules: Start with one captain and two followers, with a bounded reinforcement count of zero.
Suggested first bonus: a small damage bonus on future committed follower attacks while the captain is in support range.
Killing the captain removes future support; already locked attacks keep their committed meaning.
Existing Pack Chorister and guards overlap this space. Review whether to extend those identities or add the proposed new ones.
combos.counterplay: Pick off the captain, separate followers from its range, or exploit friendly fire and area attacks.
combos.biomes: Candidate homes: Overgrown Ruins or Ashen Bastion.

cue.name: Rally banner
cue.purpose: A static flag identifies the leader and supported followers; no new animation timeline is proposed.
